SELECT arrayIntersect( range(256 + number % 2), if(number % 2 = 0, emptyArrayUInt64(), range(16 + number % 2)), range(256 + number % 2)) FROM numbers(100000) FORMAT Null
SELECT arrayIntersect( range(256 + number % 2), if(number % 10 = 0, range(16 + number % 2), emptyArrayUInt64()), range(256 + number % 2)) FROM numbers(100000) FORMAT Null
